text:
maria: heads up — proposing reorganize left nav into 4 top-level groups: Projects, Models, Deployments, Observability. want feedback on deeplink patterns + a11y implications :wave:

noah: love the clusters. question: how do we handle deep links to subviews? e.g., metrics overviews vs per-run details.

maria: thinking canonical routes like /projects/:projId/models/:modelId/overview and using query params for tabs. example: /projects/42/deployments?env=prod&view=table

jordan: prefer path segments for critical nav (so breadcrumbs are meaningful) — avoid storing tab state in hash.

olivia: copy nit — 'Observability' vs 'Monitoring' — user research showed Monitoring resonates more with ops teams.

lee: accessibility: keyboard nav must preserve logical order when we regroup. if clusters collapse, ensure ARIA guidelines for treegrid/toolbar; also add skip link to main content.

sam: if we change URL shape, plan redirects for existing deep links + preserve shareability. add migration plan in release notes.

maria: agree. propose to keep old routes working as aliases -> 301/302? or client-side router fallback.

noah: client-side fallback ok, but server redirects better for external links. may be more infra work.

maria: proposed minimal router mapping:

```
// new -> legacy alias mapping (example)
'/projects/:p/models/:m' -> '/p/:p/m/:m'
'/projects/:p/deployments/:d/metrics' -> '/p/:p/deploy/:d#metrics'
```

olivia: tiny ux ask — when landing on a deep link to a collapsed cluster, expand it and focus first interactive element.

lee: also announce expansion to screen readers: use aria-live polite.

jordan: concerning breadcrumbs: compute crumb labels from route segments, fallback to friendly names via mapping when id-only.

maria: +1. I'll sketch flow and update prototype in Figma. anyone want to pair on accessibility audit tomorrow? @lee?

lee: happy to. + we'll run Axe locally.

sam: timeline? can we ship nav change behind a feature flag and ramp?

maria: yes. target: flag, telemetry events for nav interactions, rollout to 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

olivia: add in-console tooltip copy for renamed groups (brief: why moved) during rollout.

noah: I'll PR router changes tomorrow. cc @eng-platform for redirects.

maria: thanks all :heart: I'll drop Figma link in this thread when ready.
